notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game ends after round 6 actions. The 4 Discipline tracks are generic keys discOne..discFour (rename per Science display). Rank values entered per player are the compared values (building count / track level). 2-player game adds a non-player faction that can take 1st/2nd in area and science scoring (reducing others' points); not modelled. Solo not modelled. Verified only against RulesPal rulebook text; official PDF not retrieved.
